title: Reliability Auditing for Downstream LLM tasks in Psychiatry: LLM-Generated Hospitalization Risk Scores
reasoning: The paper includes a significant evaluation of how LLMs make 'implicit moral judgments' regarding patient behaviors (such as donating blood or picking up litter) within a clinical risk assessment framework. It discusses how these attributions reflect the models' internal value systems and classifies these findings as an 'ethical concern' related to algorithmically coded bias.
